Former William O'Neil money manager Ross Haber sits down with Richard for Session 1 of a comprehensive CANSLIM bootcamp focused on finding market leaders. Drawing on decades of experience working alongside O'Neil building Model X's, Ross breaks down the fundamental and technical essentials of growth stock trading.

This session details how to identify top-performing stocks, read chart patterns like double bottom bases, and harness relative strength ratings. Ross also demonstrates his live screening routines, showing how to filter for liquid market leaders and evaluate quarterly earnings growth versus future estimates.

Whether exploring model books or studying classic market cycles, this deep dive provides a structured, rule-based approach to managing risk, keeping losses small, and building a professional trading process.

What You'll Learn:

✅ Core principles of the CANSLIM methodology developed by William O'Neil
✅ How to identify true market leaders using relative strength and earnings growth
✅ Proper setup identification, including double bottom bases and pivot points
✅ Live screening techniques to scan for liquid, high-performing stocks
✅ Evaluating current quarterly growth versus forward estimate revisions
✅ The importance of building stock model books to develop pattern recognition
✅ Adapting classic growth trading rules to modern market conditions

Enjoy!
